name: Vitalik Buterin
rootCause: Ether co-founder Vitalik Buterin's Twitter account is suspected to have been hacked and posted a link (actually a phishing link) to a free Proto Danksharding Memorial NFT pickup related to ConsenSys. ZachXBT says the hackers have now stolen $700,000. Upon review, the tweet containing the phishing link has been removed.

descriptions.text: Ether co-founder Vitalik Buterin's Twitter account is suspected to have been hacked and posted a link (actually a phishing link) to a free Proto Danksharding Memorial NFT pickup related to ConsenSys. ZachXBT says the hackers have now stolen $700,000. Upon review, the tweet containing the phishing link has been removed.

The Twitter account belonging to Vitalik Buterin, inventor and effective leader of the Ethereum project, was hacked to promote a crypto scam. A tweet posted to his compromised account advertised a "commemorative NFT" to celebrate the impending release of "proto-danksharding", which is the actual name for an upcoming change to the Ethereum protocol. However, the link was a scam, and anyone who connected their wallet risked having their wallet drained of its cryptocurrency and NFTs.
